corrects.statement: declared residue 'Courier New and Monospaced family-name handling (mk8_couriernew_*, mk8_mono_*)'
corrects.correction: Wrong for mk8_couriernew_*. Java zeroes both unmapped Mn in BJ mk8_couriernew_9 and mk8_couriernew_23 ('Vault \U0001D17Bq\U0001E5EE': Java 37.8062 at size 9 = 7 Courier New cells for 9 characters) because HarfBuzz 15.0.0 blocklists the reference host's Courier New GDEF (hb-ot-layout.cc 251-252, ENCODE3(588, 5078, 14418)) and synthesizes glyph classes (GDEF.hh 974-985, hb-ot-shape.cc 856-879); the default shaper then zeroes the MARK glyphs. Courier New's family name is not involved. The mk8_mono_* residue (Monospaced -> Menlo) is unaffected by this correction.

OT::GDEF::is_blocklisted lists 40 (GDEF, GSUB, GPOS) triples in HarfBuzz 15.0.0 (two Cantarell and two Padauk comments share a case each); tools/font_chain_unicode.py parses 40 and the gate re-derives 40 from the stored file. Found while generating, before any measurement.
